saas_msa.label: SaaS Master Services Agreement
saas_msa.description: Scrub commercial terms and contact PII. Preserve legal entity names' structural role via tokens so the graph can still reason about parties.
preserve: liability cap multipliers expressed as 'X months of fees'

enterprise_agreement.label: Enterprise Agreement
enterprise_agreement.description: Enterprise paper carries procurement identifiers and named security contacts. Scrub those plus all commercials.
preserve: SLA percentages expressed as uptime targets

nda.label: Non-Disclosure Agreement
nda.description: NDAs leak trade secrets and project code names. Scrub proprietary identifiers aggressively; commercials are usually absent.

dpa.label: Data Processing Agreement
dpa.description: DPAs enumerate sub-processors and data categories. Scrub named sub-processors and transfer endpoints; keep the regulatory scaffolding intact.

service_agreement.label: General Services Agreement
service_agreement.description: Consulting and services contracts with mixed commercial and contact data. Scrub identity and payment details while preserving obligations structure.

rental_lease.label: Rental / Lease Agreement
rental_lease.description: Lease and rental paperwork often includes personal identifiers, addresses, and payment traces. Scrub contact and financial identifiers while keeping tenancy obligations.

construction_contract.label: Construction / EPC Contract
construction_contract.description: Construction contracts include milestone payments, project labels, and named signatories. Scrub identity and account data while preserving performance and delay clauses.

supply_purchase_agreement.label: Supply / Purchase Agreement
supply_purchase_agreement.description: Procurement and purchase agreements include PO identifiers, pricing, and logistics contacts. Scrub identifiers while preserving delivery and warranty obligations.

manufacturing_agreement.label: Manufacturing Agreement
manufacturing_agreement.description: Manufacturing contracts often expose proprietary process names and supplier chains. Scrub identity, trade secrets, and payment identifiers.

licensing_agreement.label: IP / Licensing Agreement
licensing_agreement.description: License agreements include royalties, field-of-use limits, and confidential technology labels. Scrub named parties and proprietary identifiers while preserving grant scope.

distribution_reseller_agreement.label: Distribution / Reseller Agreement
distribution_reseller_agreement.description: Channel agreements include territory definitions, pricing schedules, and partner contacts. Scrub identifiers while preserving channel and compliance obligations.

loan_financing_agreement.label: Loan / Financing Agreement
loan_financing_agreement.description: Financing documents include account identifiers, rates, and borrower data. Scrub sensitive financial and identity fields while preserving covenant structure.

employment_contract.label: Employment Contract
employment_contract.description: Employment agreements contain personally identifying data and compensation details. Scrub personal and payment identifiers while preserving role, duties, and restrictive covenants.

partnership_joint_venture.label: Partnership / Joint Venture Agreement
partnership_joint_venture.description: JV and partnership contracts include ownership splits, partner identities, and governance mechanics. Scrub sensitive identifiers while preserving control and dispute frameworks.

general_contract.label: General Contract
general_contract.description: Conservative default policy - scrub everything structurally detectable.
